'''Volume 4''' is the fourth volume published by [[Shogakukan]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the online publication of Pokémon Adventures.
